The 15-Minute Rule

Stardust Blacksburg properties are strategically located along the "Spine" and Christiansburg's Wades Lane collector, ensuring seamless low-floor transit access across the New River Valley.

CPI PolyPass Accepted Here

Local Network: Blue Ridge Transit

Your CPI ID is your fare. Our properties on Progress Street (Blacksburg) and Wades Lane (Christiansburg) are anchored directly along the high-frequency corridors of the Blue Ridge Transit network, ensuring you never have to fight for a parking spot on campus.

Route 1: The Spine Every 15 Min

Corridor: Christiansburg Transit Center (Falling Branch Exit 118) Pepper Plaza N. Franklin / S. Main St Progress St CPI.

The heavy lifter. Anchored by VDOT's 8-level, 6,000-space intercept garage at Exit 118 (with WSDOT-style bus-only flyover ramps onto US-460). 60-foot Prairie Coachworks articulated buses deployed continuously during peak hours and Crucible game days, with select train-timed trips deviating via Mill Ln NE & Depot St NE to Cambria Station (800 Depot St NE).

Route 2: The Christiansburg Local Every 30–60 Min (7 Days)

Corridor: Pepper Plaza Wades Ln (Ironwood at Wades Lane North & South) Blue Ridge Regional Aquatic Center (Mill Ln NE) Cambria Station (800 Depot St NE) Cambria / Gibbons / Berkshire / Windsor / Majestic New River Valley Mall Transit Center.

All-day neighborhood collector serving our two Wades Lane residential complexes, the Forgers' 50-meter competition pool on Mill Lane NE, and Cambria Station before terminating at New River Valley Mall Transit Center for timed transfers to Route 1 and regional express coaches.

Route 3: The Radford Link Every 30 Min

Corridor: Pepper Plaza McConnell Transit Center (Radford Univ).
Perfect for dual-enrolled students or visiting friends at RU.

Route 8: The Riner Run Hourly

Corridor: Pepper Plaza Riner.
Connection to rural medical services.

Game-Day Transit Lore: Discover how VDOT's 6,000-space Christiansburg Transit Center and BRT's bus-only Southgate Drive corridor defeat the $150 stadium parking trap.
Read Falling Branch Lore

Regional Connections

Need to leave the bubble? The PolyPass works on regional partners too.

BT
The Maroon Express (Bluewater)

Route: Bluewater / Carroll County Exit 98 (Justin's Station) Falling Branch (Exit 118) New River Valley Mall CPI.
45-foot over-the-road coach service with mid-coach ADA lifts. A cultural phenomenon for commuters along the I-81 corridor.

RVT
Roanoke Valley Transit (Roanoke Express)

Route: CPI New River Valley Mall Falling Branch (Exit 118) Roanoke (Third Street Station).
Direct connection to downtown Roanoke internships and ARTS passenger rail.

Active Commute

Direct spur access to the Huckleberry Trail. Bike to class in 20 minutes, traffic-free.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.
